title: Projects
description: This is a non-exhaustive list of personal and work projects (mostly the former) I'm investing my time in with unwavering enthusiasm. Thanks to everyone who makes that possible :-)

projects.title: flycal-cli
projects.description: Ruby CLI to search Google Calendar events and find free slots — with an MCP server for agents.

projects.title: madcp
projects.description: Self-hosted Ruby host for multiple MCP integrations: HEY, Basecamp, Fatture in Cloud, Google Workspace, and more.

projects.title: mcpme
projects.description: Ruby MCP server with OAuth 2.1 that exposes a run_shell tool on the machine where it runs.

projects.title: aicli
projects.description: Natural language to shell commands — chat with OpenAI or Anthropic and run suggested commands in one flow.

projects.title: railsapp
projects.description: Opinionated Rails starter for Kamal deploys: PostgreSQL, Solid Queue/Cache/Cable, Google OAuth, and a remote DB pull task.

projects.title: buildapage
projects.description: Vue 3 + Vite template that loads tabular data from public Google Sheets, with a standalone gviz loader bundle for any page.

projects.title: migrate-notes
projects.description: Python tools to migrate notes between Notion and Markdown folders — idempotent, resumable, both directions.

projects.title: localwebdev
projects.description: Dockerized local web dev environment with Apache, SSL, PHP, and MySQL — point DOCROOT at your projects folder.

projects.title: filedepot
projects.description: Ruby CLI to push and pull versioned files between people over SSH, keyed by stable handles.

projects.title: auto-invoices
projects.description: Ruby workflow that uses GPT-4o to extract credit-card and receipt PDFs, fuzzy-match suppliers, and prep Fatture in Cloud imports.

projects.title: elastic-stack
projects.description: Dockerized ELK stack — ingest project logs via Filebeat and Logstash, search them in Kibana.

projects.title: solarplant-zonergy
projects.description: Netlify API bridge to sync a Zonergy inverter with Home Assistant — reverse-engineered from the vendor web app, including auth and captcha handling.
